chunks: And they will say: 'What is wrong with us? We do not see the men whom we used to count among the wicked.'
ai.seo_question: Who are the 'men counted among the wicked' that the disbelievers look for in Hell?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse illustrates the psychological torment of the disbelievers who, in life, mocked the righteous as 'evil' due to their humility or asceticism, only to realize in the Hereafter that these were the true guides. This divine reversal underscores the concept of *Taqwa* (God-consciousness) as the true metric of worth, contrasting worldly perceptions with eternal reality. The lament serves as a warning against judging others by superficial standards rather than their spiritual depth.
